6 high memorystream-unbounded-growth Legacy managed encryption grows a default MemoryStream and then copies it with ToArray.
Explanation and snippet

On the non-NET target branches, each Encrypt call accumulates a caller-sized protected payload in a default-capacity MemoryStream through direct and CryptoStream writes, then makes a second full copy with ToArray. The final output size is derivable from the plaintext length, block size, header, and MAC, so large inputs can trigger avoidable growth copies and peak memory. The net12.0 branch already uses a sized pooled writer and is not affected.

Removed exact matches (11)

These are the only findings omitted from the table above. Each was matched to a PR by inspecting the patch and confirming that it removes the finding's concrete source behavior.

  1. dictionary-containskey-before-indexer
    src/Components/Components/src/RenderTree/RenderTreeDiffBuilder.cs:337-342
    Render-tree keyed lookup probes each old sibling key before inserting it.

    Covered by #70133. The old-sibling insertion now uses TryAdd, so duplicate detection and insertion share one dictionary probe instead of ContainsKey plus indexer assignment.

  2. linq-char-set-search-on-string
    src/Identity/Extensions.Core/src/PasswordValidator.cs:51
    Password validation uses LINQ All to scan every UTF-16 character.

    Covered by #70223. password.All(IsLetterOrDigit) is replaced by an explicit short-circuiting character loop.

  3. linq-char-set-search-on-string
    src/Identity/Extensions.Core/src/PasswordValidator.cs:56
    Password digit validation uses LINQ Any over the string.

    Covered by #70223. password.Any(IsDigit) is replaced by an explicit short-circuiting character loop.

  4. linq-char-set-search-on-string
    src/Identity/Extensions.Core/src/PasswordValidator.cs:61
    Password lowercase validation uses LINQ Any over the string.

    Covered by #70223. password.Any(IsLower) is replaced by an explicit short-circuiting character loop.

  5. linq-char-set-search-on-string
    src/Identity/Extensions.Core/src/PasswordValidator.cs:66
    Password uppercase validation uses LINQ Any over the string.

    Covered by #70223. password.Any(IsUpper) is replaced by an explicit short-circuiting character loop.

  6. linq-char-set-search-on-string
    src/Identity/Extensions.Core/src/UserValidator.cs:61-62
    Username validation enumerates the username with LINQ and searches the allowed-character string for every character.

    Covered by #70224. The LINQ Any plus per-character allowed-string Contains scan is replaced by SearchValues.ContainsAnyExcept or a direct loop with IndexOf.

  7. full-sort-for-top-n-selection
    src/Middleware/ResponseCompression/src/ResponseCompressionProvider.cs:147-149
    Compression negotiation fully sorts candidates to select one provider.

    Covered by #70132. Candidate selection changed from sorting the complete candidate set and taking First to maintaining the best candidate as entries are added.

  8. memorystream-unbounded-growth
    src/Middleware/Session/src/DistributedSession.cs:273-274
    Session serialization accumulates the complete, potentially large session payload in a default growable MemoryStream.

    Covered by #70169. CommitAsync now receives one exact-sized byte array from Serialize; Serialize precomputes the payload length and writes directly to it instead of growing a MemoryStream and copying with ToArray.

  9. memorystream-unbounded-growth
    src/Security/Authentication/Core/src/PropertiesSerializer.cs:19-28
    Authentication properties serialize through an unbounded growable MemoryStream.

    Covered by #70172. The built-in PropertiesSerializer fast path likewise bypasses its default MemoryStream/BinaryWriter serialization path.

  10. memorystream-unbounded-growth
    src/Security/Authentication/Core/src/TicketSerializer.cs:30-36
    Authentication ticket serialization grows a MemoryStream and then copies the complete ticket.

    Covered by #70172. The built-in TicketSerializer fast path no longer serializes through MemoryStream/BinaryWriter; it writes the same ticket format through BinaryPayloadWriter.

  11. single-use-container-built-before-enumeration
    src/SignalR/common/Protocols.MessagePack/src/Protocol/MessagePackHubProtocolWorker.cs:268-283
    Stream IDs are accumulated in a temporary List and immediately copied to an array.

    Covered by #70143. The parser allocates string[streamIdCount], assigns each parsed ID directly, and returns it; the temporary List and ToArray are gone.
